test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct direct speech form of the following sentence.

Robinson said that he would be planting trees along the bank of the river.

options.text: Robinson said, "I am planting trees along the bank of the river."
Robinson said, "I shall plant trees along the bank of the river."
Robinson said, "I shall be planting trees along the bank of the river.
Robinson said, "I shall have to plant trees along the bank of the river."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** Robinson said that he would be planting trees along the bank of the river.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"he would be planting" becomes "I shall be planting"**
 
 
• The pronoun "he"
